identity.name: MongoDB MCP Server
identity.one_liner: Model Context Protocol server for connecting AI assistants to MongoDB databases and Atlas clusters.
identity.short_description: MongoDB MCP Server is an open-source Model Context Protocol server that connects AI assistants and agent tools to MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters. It gives agents a structured way to inspect and work with MongoDB data through MCP.

positioning.why_it_matters: Databases are one of the highest-value tool surfaces for agents, but they need controlled access. MongoDB MCP Server provides an official-looking open-source connector path for MongoDB and Atlas workflows.
best_for: Developers connecting agents to MongoDB databases
Teams building MCP tool layers around data stores
MongoDB Atlas users evaluating AI assistant access
not_for: Teams that do not use MongoDB
Workflows that cannot expose database access to an agent tool even with permissions

seo_article.intro: MongoDB MCP Server connects AI assistants to MongoDB databases and MongoDB Atlas clusters through Model Context Protocol.
seo_article.what_it_is: It is a connector plugin for agent hosts that support MCP.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Database access is powerful and risky, so agents need a controlled interface rather than raw credentials in prompts.
seo_article.how_it_works: Start in a development database, configure permissions carefully, and inspect all available operations before giving an agent broader access.

faq.question: Is MongoDB MCP Server open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The repository is listed under the Apache-2.0 license.

faq.question: Who should use it?
faq.answer: Teams that use MongoDB and want to expose database context to MCP-compatible AI assistants should evaluate it.
